_comment: Manage mode: Engine Console may start engine containers from the listed images, download into writable roots and run the listed scripts. Every switch below is a deliberate choice. Paths, the script and both digests are examples (the digests are the llama.cpp adapter's default and the gateway image earlier console versions used): pin what you have reviewed.
_engine_images: repository:* allows any tag of that repository, and a tag names whatever image was last pulled under it. Prefer exact references pinned by digest (repository@sha256:<digest>) for the images you have reviewed, and pin the same references for this machine in the console (host_image_pins). The console refers to llama.cpp by digest already.

scripts.name: big-model
scripts.label: Big model (2 GPUs)
scripts.description: Starts before the small model; the script handles the order.
